channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Flanagan secures another progressive win in Minnesota Senate primary
item.description: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan won the Minnesota Democratic Senate primary, marking another success for insurgent progressives over establishment candidates.

item.title: Russia aids China's submarine tech, eroding US naval edge
item.description: Retired Rear Adm. Mark Montgomery warns Russia is sharing submarine quieting technology with China, potentially undermining a key US Navy advantage.

item.title: FBI reports 6,000 arrests, 44% homicide drop in DC crackdown
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel says the Washington, D.C., crime initiative led to over 6,000 arrests and 1,300 illegal firearm seizures in one year.
